mapper.select: SELECT D.PARK_ID, (SELECT P.PARK_NAME FROM SMT_PARK P WHERE P.ID = D.PARK_ID) PARK_NAME, COUNT(D.ID) BUILDING_NUMBER, (SELECT SUM(R.BED_TOTAL) FROM SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM R WHERE R.PARK_ID = D.PARK_ID) TOTAL, (NVL((SELECT COUNT(S.ID) FROM SMT_DORMITORY_STAFF S LEFT JOIN SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM M ON M.ID = S.ROOM_ID WHERE S.PARK_ID = D.PARK_ID AND M.IS_DORMITORY_ROOM = 0),0) + NVL((SELECT sum(S.BED_TOTAL) FROM SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM S WHERE S.PARK_ID = D.PARK_ID AND S.IS_DORMITORY_ROOM = 1),0)) ACTUAL_NUMBER FROM SMT_DORMITORY D WHERE D.PARK_ID = #{parkId} GROUP BY D.PARK_ID

SELECT D.ID DORMITORY_ID,D.PARK_ID, min(D.DORMITORY_NAME) DORMITORY_NAME, NVL(SUM(R.BED_TOTAL), 0) TOTAL, (SELECT COUNT(S.ID) FROM SMT_DORMITORY_STAFF S WHERE S.PARK_ID = D.PARK_ID and S.DORMITORY_ID=D.ID ) ACTUAL_NUMBER FROM SMT_DORMITORY D LEFT JOIN SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM R ON D.ID = R.DORMITORY_ID WHERE D.PARK_ID = #{parkId} GROUP BY D.PARK_ID,D.ID

SELECT L.FLOOR_ID, L.FLOOR_NAME, L.TOTAL, L.MAN_TOTAL, L.WOMAN_TOTAL, L.ACTUAL_MAN_NUMBER, L.ACTUAL_WOMAN_NUMBER, (L.ACTUAL_MAN_NUMBER + L.ACTUAL_WOMAN_NUMBER) ACTUAL_NUMBER FROM (SELECT R.FLOOR_ID, (SELECT F.FLOOR_NAME FROM SMT_DORMITORY_FLOOR F WHERE F.ID = R.FLOOR_ID) FLOOR_NAME, (SELECT SUM(M.BED_TOTAL) FROM SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM M WHERE M.DORMITORY_ID = R.DORMITORY_ID AND R.FLOOR_ID = M.FLOOR_ID) TOTAL, (SELECT SUM(M.BED_TOTAL) FROM SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM M WHERE M.DORMITORY_ID = R.DORMITORY_ID AND R.FLOOR_ID = M.FLOOR_ID AND M.ROOM_SEX = 0) MAN_TOTAL, (SELECT SUM(M.BED_TOTAL) FROM SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM M WHERE M.DORMITORY_ID = R.DORMITORY_ID AND R.FLOOR_ID = M.FLOOR_ID AND M.ROOM_SEX = 1) WOMAN_TOTAL, (SELECT COUNT(F.ID) FROM SMT_DORMITORY_STAFF F LEFT JOIN SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM Y ON F.ROOM_ID = Y.ID WHERE F.DORMITORY_ID = R.DORMITORY_ID AND F.FLOOR_ID = R.FLOOR_ID AND Y.ROOM_SEX = 0) ACTUAL_MAN_NUMBER, (SELECT COUNT(F.ID) FROM SMT_DORMITORY_STAFF F LEFT JOIN SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM Y ON F.ROOM_ID = Y.ID WHERE F.DORMITORY_ID = R.DORMITORY_ID AND F.FLOOR_ID = R.FLOOR_ID AND Y.ROOM_SEX = 1) ACTUAL_WOMAN_NUMBER FROM SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM R LEFT JOIN SMT_DORMITORY_STAFF S ON R.ID = S.ROOM_ID WHERE R.DORMITORY_ID = #{dormitoryId} GROUP BY R.FLOOR_ID, R.FLOOR_ID) L ORDER BY L.FLOOR_ID

SELECT ROOM.ID, ROOM.ROOM_NAME, ROOM.BED_TOTAL, TY.TYPE_NAME,TY.ID TYPE_ID,ROOM.IS_DORMITORY_ROOM, ROOM.ROOM_SEX ,USEBED.USED FROM SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM ROOM INNER JOIN SMT_DORMITORY_TYPE TY ON ROOM.ROOM_TYPE=TY.ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(1) USED,ROOM_ID FROM SMT_DORMITORY_STAFF GROUP BY ROOM_ID) USEBED ON ROOM.ID=USEBED.ROOM_ID WHERE ROOM.FLOOR_ID =#{floorId} ORDER BY ROOM_NAME

select count(1) from SMT_DORMITORY_BED bed inner join SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM room on bed.ROOM_ID=room."ID" inner join SMT_DORMITORY_LEVEL LEV on LEV.DORMITORY_TYPE_ID=room.room_type WHERE ROOM_SEX=#{sex} and LEV.jche_id=#{jcheId} AND bed.PARK_ID=#{parkId}

select room.ROOM_TYPE,min(dtype.TYPE_NAME) typeName,sum(room.BED_TOTAL) bedTotal,room.ROOM_SEX ,(select count(*) from SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM dr join SMT_DORMITORY_STAFF ds on dr.ID=ds.ROOM_ID where dr.PARK_ID=room.PARK_ID and dr.ROOM_TYPE=room.ROOM_TYPE and dr.ROOM_SEX=room.ROOM_SEX) as useBedNum from SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM room join SMT_DORMITORY_TYPE dtype on room.ROOM_TYPE=dtype.ID where room.PARK_ID=#{parkId} GROUP BY room.ROOM_TYPE,room.ROOM_SEX,room.PARK_ID

select min(PARK_ID) as PARK_ID,min(DORMITORY_ID) as DORMITORY_ID ,ROOM_ID,count(*) actCount from SMT_DORMITORY_STAFF
and ROOM_ID in
#{item}
GROUP BY ROOM_ID

select room.ID,room.ROOM_NAME,room.FLOOR_ID,floor.FLOOR_NAME from SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM room join SMT_DORMITORY_FLOOR floor on room.FLOOR_ID=floor.ID where room.DORMITORY_ID=#{dormitoryId} order by room.ID asc
mapper.update: update SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM set BED_TOTAL=BED_TOTAL-1 where ID=#{roomId}
update SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM set BED_TOTAL=BED_TOTAL+1 where ID=#{roomId}
